Well, to answer your question, space exploration is important because we do research and get information about many things. You have a point that space exploration is used for a lot of scientific study, but it is very expensive and there is less public money to pay for it nowadays. It isn't cheap to run space programmes, but the money we spend is certainly worth it. Government and public money must be included.
